name: Doki Doki c Summer Time!
original_name: ドキドキ c Summer Time!
source:
This is the journey of love that started in the midst of summer...

Just before the Choice Battle, you, a member of the Millefiore Famiglia, go on a for-fun trip to Japan.

Hot springs... swimming at the beaches... fireworks and the summer festivals! There is so much to do that you don't even know where to begin!

Whether you fall in love or not... whether you survive your mission or not... is solely up to you.

What kind of end awaits you..?

[Translation of [URL=http://www.stellaworth.co.jp/shop/item.php?item_id=cPYqdqYcIYP]Stellaworth's product information[/URL].]
translation:
这是始于盛夏之中的恋爱旅程……

就在 Choice Battle 之前，身为米尔菲欧雷家族成员的你，踏上了前往日本的休闲旅行。

泡温泉……在海滩游泳……看烟花，参加夏日祭典！要做的事情太多了，甚至不知道该从哪里开始！

你是否会坠入爱河……能否在任务中生还……全都取决于你自己。

等待你的将会是怎样的结局……？

[Stellaworth 商品信息的翻译。]
